description: Abstract class for managing metadata about relationships in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, including methods for handling relationship definitions, loading, saving, and building relationship files for module installation.

classes.name: AbstractRelationships
classes.description: Abstract class providing metadata management and file generation functionalities for relationships within the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM environment.

methods.name: findRelatableModules
methods.description: Returns modules with subpanels that can participate in relationships, optionally including activity modules.

methods.name: validSubpanel
methods.description: Checks if a given subpanel layout file is valid.

methods.name: getRelationshipList
methods.description: Returns a list of all active (not deleted) relationship names.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific relationship by name.

methods.name: addFromPost
methods.description: Creates or updates a relationship based on $_REQUEST data.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a relationship object to the set.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Loads relationship objects from a stored PHP file.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Saves the current set of relationships to a PHP file.

methods.name: getDeployedRelationships
methods.description: Retrieves all relationships stored in the database.

methods.name: getUniqueName
methods.description: Generates a unique name for a relationship, avoiding conflicts.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Generates relationship metadata files for module installation.

methods.name: saveLabels
methods.description: Creates language files for relationship labels.

methods.name: saveSubpanelDefinitions
methods.description: Creates subpanel layout files for relationships.

methods.name: saveVardefs
methods.description: Creates vardef files for relationship link fields.

methods.name: parseDeployedModuleName
methods.description: Determines if a module name indicates a deployed or undeployed module and extracts relevant parts.
